title: The launcher never closes a pane that hosts running work
body:
Outcome: `scripts/claude/successor-launch.ts` never closes a pane, at launch or under `--retire`, while that pane hosts running work (a foreground or background process other than the idle agent, for example the C3 `batch.sh` replay); it prints `retire: kept <pane>: running work` instead.
Why: on 2026-11-10 the launcher closed pane w1D:pJ9, which hosted the C3 replay (t-hx8fq1q), at launch and without `--retire` (report of the previous lead); the operator's order was explicit that the pane must stay until t-hx8fq1q closed. The retire path (`retireMode`, successor-launch.ts:308) closes a predecessor once its agent is `idle` or `done`, which says nothing about the pane's other processes.
Proof: a test drives the launch and retire paths against a verbatim capture of `herdr pane get`/`agent get` for a pane whose agent is idle while a child process runs, and sees the pane kept; first reproduce which path closed w1D:pJ9 at launch from the launch ledger and Herdr output.
Scope: `scripts/claude/successor-launch.ts`, `test/claude/successor-launch*.test.ts`.
